import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, HuberRegressor, RANSACRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score

def robust_regression_comparison():
    # Create regression data with outliers
    np.random.seed(42)
    n = 100
    X = np.random.randn(n, 1) * 3
    true_slope, true_intercept = 2.5, 5.0
    y = true_slope * X.ravel() + true_intercept + np.random.randn(n) * 2
    
    # Add outliers
    outlier_idx = np.random.choice(n, 10, replace=False)
    y[outlier_idx] += np.random.choice([-1, 1], 10) * np.random.uniform(20, 40, 10)
    
    X = X.reshape(-1, 1)
    
    # Fit models
    ols = LinearRegression().fit(X, y)
    huber = HuberRegressor(epsilon=1.35).fit(X, y)
    ransac = RANSACRegressor(random_state=42).fit(X, y)
    
    # Predictions
    y_pred_ols = ols.predict(X)
    y_pred_huber = huber.predict(X)
    y_pred_ransac = ransac.predict(X)
    
    # Metrics on all data
    print("Performance on ALL data:")
    print(f"{'Method':<15} {'MSE':>10} {'R2':>10}")
    print("-" * 37)
    for name, pred in [('OLS', y_pred_ols), ('Huber', y_pred_huber), ('RANSAC', y_pred_ransac)]:
        mse = mean_squared_error(y, pred)
        r2 = r2_score(y, pred)
        print(f"{name:<15} {mse:>10.2f} {r2:>10.4f}")
    
    # Metrics on inliers only
    inlier_mask = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    inlier_mask[outlier_idx] = False
    print(f"\nPerformance on INLIERS only:")
    print(f"{'Method':<15} {'MSE':>10} {'R2':>10}")
    print("-" * 37)
    for name, pred in [('OLS', y_pred_ols), ('Huber', y_pred_huber), ('RANSAC', y_pred_ransac)]:
        mse = mean_squared_error(y[inlier_mask], pred[inlier_mask])
        r2 = r2_score(y[inlier_mask], pred[inlier_mask])
        print(f"{name:<15} {mse:>10.2f} {r2:>10.4f}")
    
    # Coefficient comparison
    print(f"\nTrue: slope={true_slope:.2f}, intercept={true_intercept:.2f}")
    print(f"OLS:    slope={ols.coef_[0]:.2f}, intercept={ols.intercept_:.2f}")
    print(f"Huber:  slope={huber.coef_[0]:.2f}, intercept={huber.intercept_:.2f}")
    print(f"RANSAC: slope={ransac.estimator_.coef_[0]:.2f}, intercept={ransac.estimator_.intercept_:.2f}")

robust_regression_comparison()
